kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنبلع (form VII)
# أَنْبَلِعُ (ʔanbaliʕu) /ʔan.ba.li.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# أَنْبَلِعَ (ʔanbaliʕa) /ʔan.ba.li.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# أَنْبَلِعْ (ʔanbaliʕ) /ʔan.ba.liʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
